readme:
# DataForSEO OnPage Lighthouse Audit API

Runs Google Lighthouse audits on web pages and returns detailed diagnostic reports. Pass target `url` values to evaluate on-page performance, SEO, and accessibility metrics.

## Use cases

- Audit website performance and Core Web Vitals on target pages.
- Evaluate technical SEO, accessibility, and best practice compliance.
- Diagnose on-page load bottlenecks and rendering issues.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/dataforseo/v3/on_page/lighthouse/live/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"url": "https://www.python.org/"}'
```

## Parameters

The JSON body is forwarded to the upstream endpoint (one task per call). Fields used above:

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `url` | Page URL. |

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [DataForSEO Backlinks Anchors](/model/dataforseo/v3/backlinks/anchors/live): Returns anchor text distribution metrics for backlinks pointing to a target website or page.
- [DataForSEO Backlinks List](/model/dataforseo/v3/backlinks/backlinks/live): Returns a list of external backlinks pointing to a specified target domain or webpage.
- [DataForSEO Backlinks Bulk Ranks](/model/dataforseo/v3/backlinks/bulk_ranks/live): Returns rank metrics for multiple domains or pages in bulk.
